## Server Infrastructure

Access comprehensive information about our server infrastructure, including compute resources, storage systems, and deployment environments. This guide helps teams understand available resources and plan their workloads effectively.

All production servers are monitored 24/7 with automated failover capabilities to ensure high availability and reliability.

## Server Inventory

```{r}
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

# Create sample server data
server_data <- data.frame(
  Server_Name = c("PROD-APP-01", "PROD-APP-02", "PROD-DB-01", "PROD-DB-02",
                  "DEV-APP-01", "DEV-DB-01", "TEST-APP-01", "TEST-DB-01",
                  "ANALYTICS-01", "ANALYTICS-02", "ML-GPU-01", "ML-GPU-02",
                  "WEB-01", "WEB-02", "CACHE-01", "STORAGE-01"),
  Environment = c("Production", "Production", "Production", "Production",
                  "Development", "Development", "Testing", "Testing",
                  "Analytics", "Analytics", "ML/AI", "ML/AI",
                  "Web", "Web", "Cache", "Storage"),
  CPU_Cores = c(32, 32, 64, 64, 16, 32, 16, 32,
                48, 48, 96, 96, 24, 24, 16, 8),
  RAM_GB = c(128, 128, 512, 512, 64, 256, 64, 256,
             256, 256, 512, 512, 128, 128, 64, 1024),
  Storage_TB = c(2, 2, 10, 10, 1, 5, 1, 5,
                 8, 8, 4, 4, 2, 2, 1, 50),
  Uptime_Pct = c(99.99, 99.98, 99.99, 99.99, 98.5, 98.7, 97.8, 97.5,
                 99.5, 99.4, 99.2, 99.3, 99.9, 99.8, 99.95, 99.99),
  Current_Load_Pct = c(67, 72, 54, 48, 45, 38, 32, 28,
                       78, 82, 91, 88, 56, 52, 68, 45),
  Location = rep(c("US-East", "US-West", "EU-West", "Asia-Pacific"), each = 4)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Status = case_when(
      Current_Load_Pct > 80 ~ "High Load",
      Current_Load_Pct > 60 ~ "Normal",
      TRUE ~ "Low Load"
    ),
    Health = case_when(
      Uptime_Pct >= 99.9 ~ "Excellent",
      Uptime_Pct >= 99.0 ~ "Good",
      TRUE ~ "Monitor"
    ),
    Total_Capacity_Score = round((CPU_Cores * 2 + RAM_GB + Storage_TB * 10) / 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Environment, Server_Name)

# Create interactive table
datatable(server_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 16,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE,
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel')
          ),
          filter = 'top',
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = "Server Infrastructure Overview") %>%
  formatStyle('Status',
              backgroundColor = styleEqual(
                c('High Load', 'Normal', 'Low Load'),
                c('#fff3cd', '#d1ecf1', '#d4edda')
              )) %>%
  formatStyle('Health',
              color = styleEqual(
                c('Excellent', 'Good', 'Monitor'),
                c('green', 'blue', 'orange')
              ),
              fontWeight = 'bold') %>%
  formatStyle('Current_Load_Pct',
              background = styleColorBar(c(0, 100), '#764ba2'),
              backgroundSize = '95% 75%',
              backgroundRepeat = 'no-repeat',
              backgroundPosition = 'center') %>%
  formatRound(c('Uptime_Pct', 'Total_Capacity_Score'), 2)
```

## Resource Requests

To request additional server resources or report issues:

1. Submit a ticket through the IT portal
2. Include project requirements and timeline
3. Specify estimated resource needs (CPU, RAM, Storage)
4. Allow 3-5 business days for provisioning

**Emergency contacts**: Available 24/7 for production issues
